'''Amargasaurus''' (plural: '''Amargasarai''') is an [[extinct]] sauropod dinosaur from the [[wikipedia:Cretaceous|Cretaceous]] era. A young Amargasaurus is a called an ''amargasaurus hatchling''. They can only be found in [[savage]] biomes, and can even be used to pull [[wagon]]s. They are as big as an [[elephant seal]] or [[rhinoceros]], and can be found in groups of 2 to 5. Since they are reptiles, the females can lay [[egg]]s.

Some [[dwarves]] [[like]] amargasaurai for their ''long necks'' and ''sails''.
